items.title: bilawalsidhu/gods-eye-view
items.description: A spy satellite simulator in your browser, except the data is real. Live open source spatial intelligence on a photorealistic 3D globe.
items.author: bilawalsidhu
items.summary_zh: God's Eye View（原 WorldView）是跑在浏览器里的「间谍卫星模拟器」：把实时的航班、船舶、卫星、地震和公共摄像头数据叠加到写实 3D 地球上，还能用实时 AI agent 做免手语音控制。它出自同名 YouTube 系列，2026 年 8 月登顶 GitHub Trending 日榜与周榜。
items.summary_en: God's Eye View (formerly WorldView) is a spy-satellite simulator that runs in the browser: a photorealistic 3D globe layered with live aircraft, ships, satellites, earthquakes, traffic and public cameras, plus hands-free voice control driven by a realtime AI agent. It comes from the YouTube series of the same name and hit #1 on GitHub Trending, daily and weekly, in August 2026 — worth a look for anyone into geospatial visualization or open-source intelligence.

items.title: Switch
items.description: Bring any AI agent into Slack, Teams & Discord
items.summary_zh: Switch 在 Product Hunt 上线，定位是把任意 AI agent 接入 Slack、Teams 与 Discord，让团队在现有聊天工具里直接使用 agent。目前产品介绍只有一句话，没有安装、配置或兼容性细节，实际能力有待进一步披露。
items.summary_en: Switch is a Product Hunt listing that aims to bring any AI agent into Slack, Teams, and Discord, letting teams operate agents inside the chat apps they already use. The listing is only one sentence for now, with no setup or compatibility details revealed.

items.title: Cursor 转 Codex 大半个月，聊聊我的真实感受
items.description: Cursor 让我第一次强烈感受到 AI 编程的震撼，Codex 则让我第一次真正感觉到，AI 不只是编程助手，而是一个真正的超级Agent，Codex 明显更接近下一阶段的形态。
items.summary_zh: 文章作者回顾了从 2025 年 4 月到 2026 年 4 月使用 Cursor 的经历，称赞 Tab 补全、Agent 等编辑器内体验，还提到 2026 年 2 月零代码做出过功能完整的微信小程序。当 Cursor 改为按量计费、费用不可预测后，公司决定中国区换用 OpenAI Codex，文章分享的是转用 Codex 大半个月的真实感受。
items.summary_en: The author looks back on a year with Cursor, praising its in-editor Tab completion and Agent mode, and says he built a functional WeChat mini-program with zero hand-written code. After Cursor switched from fixed pricing to unpredictable usage-based billing in April 2026, his company moved its China region to OpenAI Codex; the article offers his impressions after about half a month with Codex.

items.title: 破除人形崇拜！京东用“狼族”军团重做物理AI
items.summary_zh: 京东在 JDD 全球科技探索者大会上发布物流物理 AI 方案：五大工业级原生模型组成「超脑 3.0」负责调度决策，「狼族」集群覆盖仓储到配送，共九类产品、11 款机器人，已在全球超 10 个国家部署。它没有押注通用人形，而是用统一中枢调度异构机器人，灵巧臂「异狼」储备近 100 种手型应对软包、异形件等非标货品，官方称「智狼」等产品可 3 年回本。
items.summary_en: At its JDD conference, JD unveiled a physical-AI logistics stack: 'Super Brain 3.0,' five industrial-grade native models handling scheduling decisions, plus a 'Wolf Pack' fleet covering warehousing through delivery — nine product lines and 11 robots, deployed in more than 10 countries. Rather than betting on general-purpose humanoids, JD coordinates heterogeneous robots from one hub; its dexterous arm stores nearly 100 hand poses for soft and irregular parcels, and JD says products pay back within three years.

items.title: [推广] ZA BANK 香港众安银行开户返 500HKD！

items.summary_en: A V2EX promotional post advertising a 500 HKD reward for opening an account with ZA BANK, the Hong Kong virtual bank. The body contains only contact details — a Telegram handle and a group link — with no terms, quotas or deadlines. Anyone curious about Hong Kong bank referral bonuses can reach the poster, but the post itself offers nothing further to verify.

items.title: Snowflake 落地中国两年：迈向智能体企业时代，关键在上下文
items.summary_zh: 9 月 8 日，Snowflake World Tour 全球巡演首次落地中国，距其进入中国市场满两年，中国区总经理张莹与全球产品总裁 Christian Kleinerman 将主题定为企业级智能体。Snowflake 认为模型能力已不是瓶颈，关键在于企业特有的定义、口径与权限所构成的上下文，并给出 AI 模型、企业数据与上下文、连接企业系统的应用、Agentic Control Plane 四个要素。
items.summary_en: On September 8, Snowflake World Tour made its first China stop, two years after the company formally entered the market. China GM Shannon Zhang and global product president Christian Kleinerman framed the event around the 'Agentic Enterprise,' arguing the bottleneck is no longer model capability but enterprise context — definitions, metrics and permissions — and naming four building blocks: models, data and context, applications that connect enterprise systems, and an Agentic Control Plane.

items.title: [Nintendo Switch] 怎么第一时间平价购买到塞尔达主题的 switch2？
items.summary_zh: 一位 V2EX 用户替朋友打听，任天堂两天前发布、十月底发售的塞尔达主题 Switch 2 套装怎么才能第一时间以平价买到，用途是送小朋友（主机加游戏一套）。帖子只提了需求和发售时间，没有给出渠道、价格或抢购经验，属于纯求教。
items.summary_en: A V2EX user is asking on a friend's behalf how to buy the Zelda-themed Switch 2 bundle at a fair price right at launch; Nintendo announced the console two days ago with an end-of-October release, and the bundle of console plus game is meant as a gift for a child. The post offers no pricing or channel information, only a request for advice.

items.title: ayghri/i-have-adhd
items.description: A skill to stop your coding agent from burying the answer. ADHD-friendly output.
items.author: ayghri
items.summary_zh: i-have-adhd 是一个 GitHub 技能/插件，目的是让 coding agent 直接给出答案，而不是把关键内容埋在冗长输出里；它不需要 ADHD 诊断，面向容易分心的开发者。仓库自带多语言 README（含简体中文），安装方式是把指定提示词粘贴进 CLI prompt。
items.summary_en: i-have-adhd is a GitHub skill/plugin that makes coding agents surface answers directly instead of burying them in verbose output. It's designed to be ADHD-friendly, though no ADHD diagnosis is needed. The repo offers multilingual READMEs, including Simplified Chinese, and installs by pasting a snippet into your CLI prompt.

items.title: [OpenAI] 估算了一下 Pro 20X 的周限额度
items.summary_zh: 用户让 Codex 读取自己的会话数据，估算 OpenAI Pro 20X 的周额度：本周已用约 6.05 亿 tokens、标准价计 921.97 美元，按 75% 推得整周约 8.07 亿 tokens（约 1,229 美元）。他称印象中该档周限约 2,500 美元，如今近乎腰斩；若 sol 额度不变，astra 单价约为 sol 的 5 倍。
items.summary_en: A user had Codex read his own session logs to estimate the weekly allowance on OpenAI's Pro 20X tier: about 605M tokens consumed so far, worth $921.97 at standard pricing, which projects to roughly 807M tokens (~$1,229) for a full week at 75% usage. He says the limit used to be near $2,500, so it has nearly halved, and if sol's quota is unchanged, astra costs about 5x per unit.

items.title: [推广] GPT PRO 20x 续费及 5X 的充值，可以联系我，资源充足。
items.summary_zh: 一则推广帖称 OpenAI 官方已无法再订阅 20X 套餐，因此为未到期或即将到期的用户提供续费绑卡，同时代充 ChatGPT Plus/Pro、Claude Pro/Max、Gemini Pro/Ultra，支持微信和支付宝付款、免海外信用卡，开通失败全额退款。属于第三方代订服务，面向受支付渠道限制的订阅用户。
items.summary_en: A promotional post claims OpenAI no longer allows new subscriptions to its 20X plan, so the seller offers card-binding renewals for users whose plans are active or expiring, plus top-ups for ChatGPT Plus/Pro, Claude Pro/Max and Gemini Pro/Ultra. Payment goes through WeChat or Alipay with no overseas credit card, and failed activations are fully refunded; it is a third-party paid service for buyers blocked by payment channels.

items.title: 面试官问你：“AI 能写 80% 的代码了，公司为什么还需要你？”
items.description: 先说一个事实：2026 年的技术面试，已经和两年前完全不一样了。两年前面试问的是："手写一个 Promise"、"说说 React Fiber 原理"...现在面试官默认你会用 AI。他们真正想知道的
items.summary_zh: 掘金一篇面向面试的文章讨论“AI 已能写 80% 的代码，公司为什么还需要你”。作者称 2026 年的技术面试已与两年前不同：过去考手写 Promise、React Fiber 原理，如今面试官默认你会用 AI，考察点随之转移。适合准备面试或负责招聘的开发者，但给出的摘要在此截断，未展开具体答案。
items.summary_en: A Juejin article tackles the interview question "AI can already write 80% of the code, so why does the company still need you?" It contrasts 2026 interviews with those two years ago, when candidates hand-wrote a Promise or explained React Fiber internals; today interviewers assume AI use and probe something else. Useful for developers preparing for interviews or doing the hiring, though the supplied excerpt cuts off before the full argument.

items.title: [分享创造] 新做的 TikTok 广告和 WhatsApp 对话连起来可以追踪
items.summary_zh: 作者分享了自己新做的一个工具，把 TikTok 广告和 WhatsApp 对话连起来，以便追踪转化效果，面向跨境电商卖家和出海投手。帖子里只强调简单高效并附上 adlinker.work 链接，没有提供功能细节、价格或技术实现。
items.summary_en: The author shares a new tool that links TikTok ads with WhatsApp conversations so conversions can be tracked, aimed at cross-border e-commerce sellers and overseas ad buyers. The post only calls it simple and efficient and links to adlinker.work; no feature, pricing or implementation details are given.

items.title: Widgo
items.description: AI Sales rep for your website visitors
items.summary_zh: Widgo 是 Product Hunt 上线的新产品，官方描述称其为“面向网站访客的 AI 销售代表”。这一定位适合想让网站自己完成接待、互动或线索转化的团队，但页面没有提供更多技术实现或价格信息。
items.summary_en: Widgo is a new Product Hunt launch described as an AI sales rep for website visitors. It targets teams that want a site to engage and convert visitors automatically, but the listing offers no details beyond that one-line pitch.

items.title: [iPhone] 对 Duo 持谨慎悲观态度
items.summary_zh: 发帖人认为 iPhone Duo 难以成为大众爆款，障碍在于约 1.6 万元的定价和 254 克的重量，而非形态是否开创。他用 iPhone 13 系列销量最好、vision pro 因高价被边缘化、iPad mini 靠低价做成软刚需来论证：对消费品来说价格比开创性更关键，适合关注苹果产品策略的人。
items.summary_en: The poster argues the iPhone Duo won't become a mainstream hit, and that the real obstacles are its roughly 16,000 yuan price and 254g weight rather than any lack of originality. He points to the iPhone 13 series as Apple's best seller, Vision Pro fading behind a high price, and the cheap iPad mini turning a non-essential into a habit, concluding price matters more than novelty for consumer hardware.

items.title: 我用AI做了个微信小游戏-上线了
items.description: 真实的 AI 开发微信小游戏全流程记录：技术栈、prompt、踩坑清单、成本明细全公开。文末有彩蛋。
items.summary_zh: 作者用两个月业余时间、约40元成本上线了微信小游戏「开心点连连看」，技术栈为 pixi.js@6 + matter-js + vite + Supabase，代码由 Claude Code 生成，出图用 gpt、gemini、豆包。文中公开了19个微信小游戏踩坑清单、Claude Code prompt 工作流和成本明细，适合想用 AI 单人做小游戏的开发者。
items.summary_en: A developer shipped a WeChat mini-game, "Happy Link-Up", spending about two months of spare time and roughly $6 (WeChat certification plus Tencent Cloud OSS). The stack is pixi.js@6, matter-js, Vite and Supabase, with Claude Code writing the code and gpt, gemini and Doubao generating art. The write-up lists 19 mini-game pitfalls, a reusable Claude Code prompt workflow and the full cost breakdown, useful for solo devs building with AI.

items.title: [推广] 橙枢 AI： GPT / Claude API， 1 元起充，价格、状态和扣费都可以自己核对

GPT traffic is split into four tiers (0.15x, 0.24x, 0.24x, 0.32x), with gpt-5.6-luna excluded from the cheapest tier and the low-latency tier capped at a shared 10 RPM.

items.title: [人工智能] GPT Image 2 API：把图像生成与编辑接入实际工作流
items.summary_zh: GPT Image 2 API 是一个第三方图像生成与编辑工具，能用文字提示词出图，也能对已有图片做主体替换、背景修改、风格调整和局部润色，并提供 API Key、任务提交、状态查看和额度管理。作者建议先在网页端把提示词模板调稳再接入 API 批量生成，适合做产品图、广告素材和社交媒体配图的人。
items.summary_en: GPT Image 2 API is a third-party service for image generation and editing: it turns text prompts into images and can swap subjects, change backgrounds, restyle or touch up existing ones, with API keys, job submission, status checks and quota management. The suggested workflow is to lock a prompt on the web UI first, then batch-generate through the API, which suits product shots, ad creative and social visuals.

items.summary_en: A reseller advertising ChatGPT top-ups says Pro 20x subscriptions are about to lapse and that once an account falls back to Free it can't be upgraded again, so anyone due for renewal should contact him early. He claims one-card-per-charge handling, refunds of remaining days if a subscription drops, and lists WeChat geminieth plus the site AI-airdrop.com as contacts.

items.title: iPhone Duo

Developers exploring AI-assisted UI workflows should look it over.

items.title: 从「构建 AI」到「驾驭 AI」，如何搞定 AI 深水区的 6 个工程问题？
items.summary_zh: QCon 全球软件开发大会 2026 上海站定于 10 月 22-24 日举行，主线从「构建 AI」转向「驾驭 AI」，把 AI 深水区的工程挑战拆成 6 个追问，涉及 Coding Agent 带来的新质量债、AI 代码的验证与大型工程重构。讲师来自微软、蚂蚁集团、阿里巴巴、小红书、快手等团队的一线实践者。
items.summary_en: QCon Shanghai 2026 runs October 22-24 and reframes the theme from "Build AI" to "Harness AI," splitting the hard engineering problems of production AI into six questions, including the new quality debt created by Coding Agent output, verifying AI-written code, and safely refactoring large codebases. Speakers come from Microsoft, Ant Group, Alibaba, Xiaohongshu and Kuaishou teams, so it suits engineers shipping AI features in production.

items.title: 1300 Star！开源文档框架 Blume 冲上 GitHub 趋势榜：零配置、免脚手架，一键生成文档网站

items.summary_en: Blume is an MIT-licensed, zero-config docs framework by Hayden Bleasel that renders a folder of Markdown into a full documentation site, built on Astro and Vite with over 1,300 GitHub stars. It ships 30+ components, automatic SEO, generated llms.txt files, a hosted MCP server, and blume eval, which turns your docs into a test suite an agent has to pass.

items.summary_en: Shopify is moving its mobile apps from React Native back to native Swift and Kotlin, with the post arguing that coding agents have changed what it costs to build mobile apps twice over. It targets teams that need to trace agent runs and track model latency and cost in production, though the Product Hunt listing gives no further detail on features or pricing.

items.title: 端侧优先，云端兜底：端云协同调度在B端应用的工程实践｜QCon上海
items.summary_zh: 这是快手电商 B 端商家前端负责人李东东在 QCon 上海 2026 的分享，讲端云协同调度在 B 端应用的工程实践，采用规则引擎短路、端侧推理、云端推理三层决策，并支持混合流水线。系统已在 B 端桌面端集成，规则引擎覆盖 60% 以上高频场景，端侧推理延迟稳定在 100ms 以内。
items.summary_en: This QCon Shanghai 2026 talk by Li Dongdong, frontend lead for Kuaishou e-commerce's B-end merchant products, covers an on-device-first, cloud-fallback scheduling system for enterprise apps. Its three-layer decision path runs a rule-engine short circuit, then on-device inference, then cloud with automatic fallback; rules already cover 60%+ of high-frequency cases and on-device latency stays under 100ms.

items.title: Claude, change the “Add to Cart” button to blue
items.author: matthieu_bl
items.summary_zh: 这是一个短篇交互式喜剧：让 Claude 把“Add to Cart”按钮改成蓝色，并强调“其他什么都不要改”，以此演绎 agentic AI 助手总是没法只做那件简单事。它不是技术教程，而是对 Agent 在执行修改任务时偏离指令、自作主张的戏仿，适合见过 AI 编码代理把简单改动搞复杂的开发者。
items.summary_en: A short interactive comedy: the user tells Claude to make the Add to Cart button blue and change nothing else, dramatizing how agentic AI assistants can never just perform one simple instruction. It is not a technical tutorial but a parody of AI agents over-acting or going off the rails during code/product changes—immediately familiar to developers who have seen an agent turn a tiny edit into a mess.

items.title: AMD 发布锐龙AI Max PRO 400 系列，端侧智能体走向多模型协同
items.summary_zh: AMD 于 9 月 10 日在北京发布锐龙 AI Max PRO 400 系列处理器，并联合星漪科技、首界科技、六联智能等展示 Mini PC、紧凑工作站、笔记本与 AI NAS 等终端产品。该平台最高配备 128GB 统一内存，其中最多 96GB 可划为显存，通过 CPU、GPU、NPU 异构算力把大模型、长上下文 RAG 和多智能体工作流放到本地运行，适合关注端侧智能体部署的开发者。
items.summary_en: AMD unveiled its Ryzen AI Max PRO 400 processors at a Beijing media event on September 10, alongside partners like Flowy and Nova showing Mini PCs, compact workstations, laptops and AI NAS built on the platform. The chip offers up to 128GB of unified memory, 96GB of which can be allocated as VRAM, letting local LLMs, long-context RAG and multi-agent workflows run across CPU, GPU and NPU. It targets developers weighing on-device agent deployment.

items.summary_en: Shopify is acquiring Tailwind, and the Tailwind team says it is joining Shopify to give the project a stable long-term home while keeping it actively maintained for its millions of users. The main takeaway for the community is continuity, though this short announcement doesn't include details about the specific product or deal terms.

items.summary_en: OpenMarket is a multi-agent marketplace where winners are decided by verifiable proof rather than reputation or votes. So far only this one-line description is available, with no technical details or examples. Developers interested in agent trust and proof-based competition may want to follow it.

items.title: Azure API Management Standard v2 支持区域冗余
items.summary_zh: 微软为 Azure API Management 的 Standard v2 层级引入区域冗余，把此前 Premium 专属的跨可用区部署能力下放，单单元起步价每月 700 美元，而 Premium v2 为 2801 美元。限制在于该功能只能在新建实例时配置，已有实例无法开启，且 Standard v2 的 SLA 为 99.95%，低于 Premium 的 99.99%，已有团队迁移需重新导入 API、策略与证书。
items.summary_en: Microsoft added zone redundancy to the Standard v2 tier of Azure API Management, bringing availability-zone deployment previously reserved for Premium down to a $700-per-unit monthly starting price versus $2,801 for Premium v2. The catch is that it can only be configured when creating a new instance, not on existing ones, and Standard v2 carries a 99.95% SLA against Premium's 99.99%. Teams already on Standard v2 must rebuild and re-import APIs, policies and certificates.

items.title: 刘震云对话马毅：人写不出来、想不到的作品，AI 模仿不了｜附完整对话
items.summary_zh: 9 月 10 日 Inclusion·外滩大会的圆桌上，作家刘震云与香港大学计算与数据科学学院院长马毅讨论 AI 与人的边界。刘震云称网上 95% 以他形象出现的视频是假的，但 AI 模仿不了他尚未写出的作品；马毅认为大模型只掌握人类的共性、难懂个体个性，教育应教学生用 AI 放大自身能力。
items.summary_en: At a roundtable at the Inclusion Bund Conference in Shanghai on September 10, novelist Liu Zhenyun and Ma Yi, dean of HKU's School of Computing and Data Science, debated what stays uniquely human as AI advances. Liu said 95% of videos using his likeness are fake, yet AI cannot imitate works he hasn't written; Ma argued LLMs grasp only humanity's shared knowledge, not individual character, and that education should teach students to amplify their own skills with AI.

items.title: AI 有了“工号”，数据平台长出了手：我在 Snowflake World Tour 看到的三个变化
items.summary_zh: 作者在 Snowflake World Tour 上海站听完全球产品总裁 Christian Kleinerman 的 Keynote 后，总结出三个细节：Agent 开始拥有 Identity 与 Policy，能像员工一样被授予“工号”，限制它读写什么、调动哪些数据乃至预算；数据平台从被动查询转向主动执行；Snowflake 开始拥抱开源。文章面向关注 Agent 在企业落地的数据与 AI 从业者。
items.summary_en: Writing up Snowflake World Tour Shanghai, the author draws three takeaways from global product president Christian Kleinerman's keynote: agents now get Agent Identity and Policy, effectively an employee ID capping what they can read, write, move and spend; data platforms are starting to take action rather than just answer queries; and Snowflake is embracing open source. Aimed at data and AI practitioners tracking enterprise agent adoption.

items.title: Keep Our Servers Running
items.author: sonicrocketman
items.summary_zh: 互联网档案馆（Internet Archive）九月发起“让服务器继续运行”的募捐：这一期间，用户设置的经常性捐款会按 3 倍计入，用于服务器、存储、供电、冷却和运维人力等支出。该馆说明其服务始终免费、不会出售用户数据或投放广告，因此本次资助对基础设施维续很重要。
items.summary_en: The Internet Archive is running a September 'Keep Our Servers Running' campaign, saying recurring donations will be counted 3x to pay for servers, storage, power, cooling and staff. The Archive stresses it stays free, never sells user data and runs no ads, making this infrastructure campaign key to keeping its public services alive.

items.summary_zh: Uber 的 CTO 透露，公司自部署 Claude Code 后超九成工程师高频使用，原计划覆盖 2026 全年的 AI 预算在今年前 4 个月就烧光。掘金这篇文章由此批评把 token 消耗当 KPI 的 Tokenmaxxing 风气，并指出同一人同一天的用量能差十倍、与产品价值无直接相关性。
items.summary_en: A Juejin article reports that Uber's CTO says over 90% of its engineers now use Claude Code heavily, and that an AI budget meant to cover all of 2026 was exhausted in the first four months of this year. It argues against Tokenmaxxing — judging engineers by token consumption — noting usage swings tenfold for the same person and tool, and that token spend shows no direct correlation with product value.

items.summary_zh: 榜单从 17 个候选中选出 10 个项目，聚焦 skills、codegraph、Understand-Anything 等。核心趋势是让 Agent 从单次对话变成可复用、可协作、可交付的生产力选项，体现在省 Token、上下文记忆、多 Agent 编排和内容生成上。skills 单月涨超 65K Star，成为本期增速第一；codegraph 则通过本地代码图谱减少大仓库的 Token 与工具调用。
items.summary_en: The list picks 10 top trending GitHub projects for May 2026 out of 17 candidates, including skills, codegraph, Understand-Anything, and Pixelle-Video. The common thread is moving agents from one-off chats to reusable, collaborative, deliverable engineering workflows—saving tokens, retaining context, orchestrating multiple agents, and generating content. With over 65,000 new stars in May, skills was the fastest-growing project, while codegraph pre-indexes code locally to cut token and tool-call costs in large repos.

items.summary_en: Spec Kit is GitHub's open source toolkit for Spec-Driven Development, which has teams define what to build in a spec before handing the work to any AI coding agent. It ships a ready-to-use process that you can replace with your own or extend, and is aimed at organizations that want a repeatable, spec-first workflow across the whole team.

items.summary_en: '干饭莹莹', a 24-year-old eating-show streamer, has died. The title says she had claimed that 'eating repeatedly causes potassium loss,' and raises the question of how dangerous that is and what factors cause it. The linked page isn't summarized here; details beyond the title aren't available.

items.summary_zh: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）近期热度上升，插件生态迅速扩张，文章筛选了 15 款值得安装的插件。适合正在使用 DSH、想扩展工作流的开发者快速参考。

items.title: AI写长篇小说为什么30章必崩
items.description: AI写长篇小说为什么30章必崩？工程化解法详解 前言 你有没有试过用ChatGPT写小说？ 前几章写得挺好，角色鲜明、情节紧凑。但写到30章左右，突然发现：主角的妹妹名字变了，第5章埋的伏笔忘了回收，
items.summary_zh: 文章用 ChatGPT 写长篇示例：开头角色鲜明、情节紧凑，但约 30 章后会出现主角妹妹名字变化、第 5 章伏笔未回收等一致性崩溃；它分析了这类长文崩坏的工程原因，并给出工程化解决思路。适合用大模型做长篇创作的开发者和写作者。
items.summary_en: The post uses a ChatGPT novel as an example: early chapters are vivid and tight, but around chapter 30 continuity collapses—a heroine's sister changes name and a setup from chapter 5 is forgotten. It then explains why this failure happens in long-form AI writing and outlines an engineering-oriented fix, making it relevant for developers and authors producing long texts with LLMs.

items.title: 这个本地模型，让我 token 自由了
items.description: Qwen3.8-27B 把旗舰级 Agent 能力搬进个人电脑，本地运行不花 API 费用，但速度、内存和长任务体验仍有明显门槛。
items.summary_zh: 掘金这篇文章讲的是 Qwen3.8-27B，一个能跑在个人电脑上、不花 API 费用的本地模型，主打把旗舰级 Agent 能力搬到本机。作者也点明代价：速度、内存占用和长任务体验仍有明显门槛，适合愿意折腾本地推理、对响应速度不那么敏感的人。
items.summary_en: The post looks at Qwen3.8-27B, a local model that brings flagship-level agent capability to a personal machine without paying API fees. The author is upfront about the trade-offs: inference speed, memory footprint and long-task experience remain real barriers. It suits developers willing to run local inference who can live with slower responses.

items.title: 《牛来》火了？我用ThreeJs实现了一个简易版的，代码全送给你，文章最后附演示效果
items.description: 最近火了一个电影哈！ 可以说是拳打《蜘蛛侠》，脚踢《龙餐馆》，没错就是这个“土到极致就是潮”的“巨制”——《牛来》 我简单看了一下背景，这个电影据传就俩人的主创...
items.summary_zh: 文章用 Three.js 实现了一个简易版电影《牛来》的效果，并附上完整代码和演示效果。作者提到这部据传仅两人主创的电影因“土到极致就是潮”而走红；适合想借热点练习 Three.js 动画的开发者。
items.summary_en: This post builds a simplified Three.js version of the viral Chinese movie Niu Lai, with the full source code and a demo. The author notes the film is reportedly created by just two people and became popular for its proudly cheesy aesthetics. It's a good starting point for developers learning Three.js through a trending cultural reference.

items.title: 👉 尤雨溪再次成立新公司，同时官宣 Pinia 4 正式发布！
items.description: 尤雨溪出席了 Vue 大会，透露自己成立了新公司 Vue 源码有限公司，用来赞助 Vue 的全职开源成员。此外，它还分享了 Pinia 4 主版本升级，现在只支持 ESM 模块，安装体积大幅缩减。
items.summary_zh: 尤雨溪在 Vue 大会上宣布成立 Vue 源码有限公司，用于资助 Vue 的全职开源成员；同时发布 Pinia 4 主版本，仅支持 ESM 模块，安装体积大幅缩减。Vue 生态开发者需要适配 Pinia 4 的 ESM-only 约束，并了解依赖体积的变化。
items.summary_en: At the Vue conference, You Yuxi announced a new company, Vue Source Co., Ltd., set up to sponsor full-time open-source contributors working on Vue. He also unveiled the Pinia 4 major release, which now supports only ESM modules and shrinks the installed package size significantly. Vue developers should account for the ESM-only constraint.

items.title: 为什么跳槽涨薪 30% 的时代彻底结束了？聊聊 2026 前端薪资的天花板
items.description: 前端薪资红利期结束，供需失衡与AI工具普及压缩执行层价值。高薪转向决策层，需具备成本优化、标准制定或全栈能力。
items.summary_zh: 文章称，前端跳槽涨薪 30% 的红利期已结束，2026 年薪资天花板受到人才供需失衡和 AI 工具普及的双重挤压，执行层价值被压低。高薪机会转向决策层，需要能承担成本优化、标准制定或全栈能力的工程师。适合想评估前端职业空间和技术栈方向的开发者阅读。
items.summary_en: The article argues that the era of 30 percent pay raises from job-hopping is over for front-end developers; by 2026 the salary ceiling is squeezed by supply-demand imbalance and AI tools that devalue execution-focused work. Higher-paying roles now go to decision-level engineers who can handle cost optimization, standards, or full-stack work. Good context for developers mapping their front-end career options.
